purpose: Define the minimal immutable anchor that binds an epoch_id to its canonical manifest CID and closes replay bootstrapping ambiguity.
validation_rules: Resolve epoch_id to exactly one canonical manifest_cid for the selected anchor chain.
Fetch manifest bytes by manifest_cid from any available storage substrate.
Hash manifest bytes and require manifest_sha256 match.
Recompute epoch_root_sha256 from manifest artifacts and require match.
Follow prev_epoch_anchor only as history linkage, never as mutable current truth.
Reject competing manifest CIDs for the same epoch unless they are explicit fork epochs.
invariants: The constitutional object is the file bound into a specific epoch topology, not the file alone.
Manifest CID is the signature block of epoch identity.
External anchors attest the manifest root, not every artifact byte directly.
Storage persistence is operational; addressing is constitutional.
Truth remains reconstructible even after infrastructure decay.
